notes: kb/Work PB1086/PB2103: Rule (cite.py --check 12.3.8.3 'the name of a function for which information exists in the external repository' -> OK 12.3.8.3 10)): literal-5 / function-prototype-name-1 shall name a function prototype of this group, a function definition specified PREVIOUSLY in this group, or a function with external-repository information. Verified: every FUNCTION specifier is resolved AT the specifier by RepositoryResolver.ResolveFunction (group definitions before the element, group prototypes, then the repository entries, plus the word alternative of 8.4.6.7), and a specifier none of them answers is REPO-1 (COBOL5962, ISO 12.3.8.3 SR10) whether or not a use follows - RepositoryResolver.ReportUnanswered names the rule and the places searched; 'previously' is a position (kb/Work PB989: a definition that FOLLOWS the paragraph is not the second alternative). Witnesses: negative pb989-function-definition-follows-the-specifier and pb1100-class-repository-function-undefined (COBOL5962 refused at 2002, 2014, 2023), UdfInvocationTests.DeclaredButUndefined_IsRepo1, ExternalRepositoryResolutionTests.AFunctionSpecifierTheGroupDoesNotAnswer_ReportsTheEntrysFault. Re-probed 2026-11-03 on the PB1086 branch (kb/Work PB1086): the note's own sr10.cob (REPOSITORY. FUNCTION NOSUCHFN, FUNCTION ALIASFN AS "NOSUCH-EXT", PROGRAM NOSUCHPG, CLASS NOSUCHCL, INTERFACE NOSUCHIF, PROPERTY NOSUCHPR) is refused at --std 2023 with COBOL5962 at each of the six specifiers, naming the rule (SR10, SR14, SR6, SR9, SR16) and the places searched; sr6.cob (PROGRAM NOSUCHPG + CALL NOSUCHPG ON EXCEPTION) is refused COBOL5962 at the specifier instead of printing NOT-FOUND at run time.
